title: Azimuth region: tiered reservation launch & partner onboarding playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Coordinate cross-functional launch of Dedicated capacity in the new Azimuth region, including two new instance families (compact-4, compact-8), a tiered reservation product (Commit, Flex, Burst), partner reseller onboarding, and choreographed release notes/comms. This ticket drives the end-to-end GTM playbook: pre-launch partner enablement, legal & billing verification, console feature flags, telemetry queries for capacity/latency SLAs, support runbooks, and release notes sequencing. Target audience: enterprise customers (SLA & compliance), partner resellers, and internal sales/CS. Success metric: first 30 days of reservations meet 90% of forecasted activation and zero critical-severity billing disputes.
acceptance_criteria: Legal sign-off on regional contract addendum and reseller terms
Billing & invoices validated in test tenant for Commit/ Flex/ Burst pricing bands
Console UI flags and SKU names released behind feature flag; SDK and API docs updated
Partner enablement kit distributed and at least two resellers have completed onboarding checklist
Release notes published with staged cadence (Early Access -> General Availability) and linked in product banner
Support runbook (oncall + escalation) published and triaged in playbook dry-run
